correctness.rationale: The zonotope intrinsic volume identities are A_n=2 sum_{i<j}|U_i cross U_j| and V_n=sum_{i<j<k}|det(U_i,U_j,U_k)|. For s=|U_i cross U_j|, E s=pi/4, E s^2=2/3, and E(|det| conditional on first two directions)=s/2. Centered pair kernel b=s/2-pi/8 has Var(b)=nu/16; the degenerate triple kernel g=d-(s_ij+s_ik+s_jk)/2+pi/4 has Var(g)=kappa, is pair-orthogonal and has uncorrelated distinct triple indices. Exact Hoeffding decomposition implies the stated covariance, variance and correlation, including strict monotonicity from the positive constants. Independent direct simulation of 20,000 n=4 zonotopes computed area and volume geometrically and measured covariance 0.59167 versus theoretical 0.59780 (1.03% relative deviation); exact algebraic correlation identity checked at n=3,4,5,8,30,120. Simulation is only corroboration.
